riskAssessment.explanation: Score is based on detected log patterns, not a live deployment prediction.

findings.title: Missing component or dependency
findings.recommendation: Verify component names, file paths, package dependencies, and deployment contents.

findings.title: Automated test failure
findings.recommendation: Inspect the failing test, expected versus actual values, and the related code changes.

findings.title: Operation timed out
findings.recommendation: Check service availability, job duration, network connectivity, and configured time limits.

disclaimer: Local pattern-based diagnostics only; this is not a live Copado deployment status.
